notes.title: Exciting News: Roborne Demo & OST Release Date Announced!
notes.notes:
Hello Robornes,

We are thrilled to share some exciting news with you! After two and a half years of dedicated development, Roborne is almost here. But that's not all—we're bringing you a special treat ahead of the official release.

Mark Your Calendars: September 4, 2024

On this date, you’ll get exclusive access to both the Roborne Demo and Original Soundtrack (OST), a full week before the official game launch on September 11th. This early release will give you the chance to dive into the game and experience its captivating music before anyone else.

Don’t miss out on this early opportunity to engage with Roborne. Be sure to add the date to your calendar, wishlist the game, and stay tuned for more updates.

Looking forward to seeing you at the factory!


Best regards,

Jayden Neuendorf
Lead Director, NSG
